about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Transferred Sixth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Nourished by Your heavenly food, O Lord, we beseech You that we may always strive after those things that give us true life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
